page_title: PAL 1-1 CAD | Las Palmas v Cadiz CF 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90+4' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Ruiz had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) will replace Maximo Perrone.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Cadiz CF have a free kick.
86' Las Palmas failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play. Las Palmas will have a chance to score from a corner.

83' 1 - 1 Chris Ramos (Cadiz) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Robert Navarro. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
83' Here is a change. Victor Chust is going off and Sergio gives the last tactical orders to Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Ivan Alejo will be replaced by Darwin Machis (Cadiz).
82' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) prepares to take a corner kick.
82' Cadiz CF have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' Alvaro Valles makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) after a cross from the side. Cadiz CF get a corner.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) is brought on as a substitute for Munir El Haddadi.
79' A player from Las Palmas pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
79' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

78' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Alvaro Valles, who pulls off a stunning save! Cadiz CF will take a corner kick.

77' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.

75' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
73' One of the players from Cadiz CF times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
69' The corner is swung in but Cadiz CF can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' A cross from Lucas Pires (Cadiz) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. It will be a corner kick for Cadiz CF.
68' The attendance for today's match is 25275.
66' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Pejino and he is replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
62' Sergio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robert Navarro (Cadiz) replacing Ruben Sobrino.
62' It will be a substitution. Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) is ready to enter the pitch as Alex Fernandez walks off.
62' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

60' It looks like Alex Fernandez (Cadiz) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Ruiz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Las Palmas are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
60' One of the Cadiz CF players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Las Palmas win a free kick.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Las Palmas.

56' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Las Palmas will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

54' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
51' Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
50' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.
49' Marvin (Las Palmas) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Now Las Palmas have a corner.
46' Here's the change. Alberto Moleiro leaves the pitch and Marvin (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' Alejandro Ruiz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Las Palmas seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45+2' Cadiz CF control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
45' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
45' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
44' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) picks up an injury.
43' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
42' Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle as Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
42' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Las Palmas win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
38' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) offside.
37' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
36' Las Palmas can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

35' Kirian Rodriguez (Las Palmas) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Conan Ledesma to dive and make a save. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Fali (Cadiz) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
32' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
31' Problems for Sergio as Roger Marti (Cadiz) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Maximiliano Gomez replaces him.
31' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) takes a mid-range free kick and his stunning strike crashes against the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
30' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Ruiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cadiz CF comes to nothing.
29' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Cadiz CF will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' The injury to Roger Marti (Cadiz) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
27' Saul Coco (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Cadiz CF.

27' Victor Chust (Cadiz) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Ruiz with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Las Palmas.
24' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) goes into the referee's book for dissent.

24' A cross is whipped in towards Roger Marti (Cadiz) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
22' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) commits a foul during an attacking move.
18' A player from Las Palmas takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cadiz CF will take a free kick near the side line.

13' Alberto Moleiro tees up Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) with a precision cross. He holds off the defender, but fires his shot just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
11' A goal, which was scored by Ivan Alejo (Cadiz), was disallowed due to offside.
9' Las Palmas are ruled offside.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Pejino (Las Palmas) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
6' Pejino (Las Palmas) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
2' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Cadiz CF are going to take it.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Ruiz was nominated as the referee for this game.
